headline: Alldigi Tech posts strong Q2 FY27 earnings with 50.9% PAT growth
hook: Profit jumps over fifty percent year-on-year
summary: Alldigi Tech Limited reported its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 in a press release dated October 29, 2026. The company delivered a 50.9% increase in profit after tax (PAT) compared to the same period last year. EBITDA grew by 28.5%, while the EBITDA margin expanded by 576 basis points to 30.2% year-on-year. For Indian retail investors, these results highlight the quarterly financial performance and margin expansion of a listed IT and digital solutions provider.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings growth boosts near-term sentiment for Alldigi shareholders
winners_losers: Alldigi shareholders gain / competitors face pressure
